wins.label: Strong sales growth
wins.evidence: We delivered 12.4% daily sales growth, our third consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

wins.label: Customer engagement and market share gains
wins.evidence: Events like these really demonstrate why we keep gaining market share.

wins.label: Digital adoption and FMI expansion
wins.evidence: We signed close to 7,000 new FMI device agreements, about 110 per day, an 8% increase over last year.

wins.label: Operating margin improvement
wins.evidence: Operating margin improved to 20.3%, up 20 basis points from last year.

wins.label: Strong cash generation
wins.evidence: Operating cash flow was approximately $378 million, representing 111% of net income.

risks.label: Tariff and pricing uncertainty
risks.evidence: Tariff uncertainty added additional challenges. In many cases, customer conversations and pricing actions took longer than usual.

risks.label: Margin pressure from cost inflation
risks.evidence: We were approximately 40 basis points below our own Q1 gross margin target as pricing actions did not keep up with cost increases.

risks.label: Pricing delays and customer pushback
risks.evidence: The real challenge to the group is we need to have those tough discussions every day.

risks.label: Fuel and transportation cost headwinds
risks.evidence: We also experienced smaller headwinds from fuel and transportation costs.

risks.label: Inventory cost inflation
risks.evidence: The headwind from the inventory conversion is now behind us, but we're getting close.

wins.label: Strong Q1 Sales Growth
wins.evidence: Daily sales increased 12.4% to $34.9 million per day for the quarter, our third consecutive quarter of double-digit growth.

wins.label: Increased Share of Wallet
wins.evidence: We gained share through focused execution, winning new business with key accounts, and expanding customer site presence.

wins.label: Strategic Driver Success
wins.evidence: Increasing sales effectiveness, driven by new national account contracts and a healthy number of signings, contributed significantly to growth.

wins.label: Expanded Customer Sites
wins.evidence: Customer sites spending $50,000 plus per month increased 16.3% year-over-year to just over 2,900 sites.

wins.label: International Growth
wins.evidence: International sales grew almost 24% in March, primarily in Europe and Asia, demonstrating continued momentum.

risks.label: Tariff-Related Margin Pressure
risks.evidence: Approximately 40 basis points of margin pressure was due to tariff-related costs, particularly in branded products.

risks.label: Pricing vs. Cost Challenges
risks.evidence: Difficulty in quickly passing on price increases due to tariff uncertainty and customer negotiations.

risks.label: Macroeconomic Uncertainty
risks.evidence: The industrial environment remains somewhat challenging, with moderate PMI levels and potential headwinds from trade and tariff uncertainty.

risks.label: Inventory Management Complexity
risks.evidence: Managing inventory levels and costs, particularly with slower inventory turnover rates for certain product lines, presented challenges.

risks.label: Competition in Branded Products
risks.evidence: Increased competition in branded products led to pricing challenges and slower adoption of new price increases.
